prosody_instruction: Speak confidently and steadily, with clear declarative tone. Decisive pacing, even rhythm, no filler words.

chunks.text: I’m in Guangzhou this week, and I’ve been thinking I should finally get a doctor lined up while I’m here.
Also, I’m flying from Beijing to Shanghai right after this, so I’m trying to keep my schedule from getting too chaotic.
On top of that, I’ve been double-checking my medicine situation so I don’t forget anything before I head out.
For the clinic stuff, it’s under Emily Wang, with Guo Ping on 2026-04-08 in the afternoon… and then I guess I’ll just see how I’m feeling after that.
